tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists Spark Pack's tools, the regulations edition it targets, what it covers (nations, circuit types, cable types, installation methods) and what it deliberately does not do. Free, needs no input.

tools.description: Answers whether domestic electrical work in England or Wales must be notified to building control under Part P of the Building Regulations, with the reason and what to do next (self-certify through a competent person scheme within 30 days, or tell building control before starting). England and Wales
